title: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life — Layered Timeline Events
purpose: Canonical presentation/index layer for timestamped project data. The readable road-map remains dominant; optional overlays add Son/Tim life tracks, direct words, scripture-at-time, later biblical parallels, creative works, public witness and research unlocks without duplicating canonical source records.
rules: Timeline events are index pointers, not replacement source records.
Roadmap events are sparse and high-significance; overlays may be denser.
Actors are independent from thematic layers: Son/Twin, Tim/Potato/Father, shared transition, and project/research.
Bible invoked at the time is distinct from a later biblical parallel and from a later research unlock.
Do not backdate later interpretation into an earlier event.
Creative work is not doctrine by default.
Exact timestamps outrank date-only and recovered ranges; precision is always explicit.
Low-value repetitive dates stay in specialist ledgers instead of flooding the public timeline.
